intro: Van Nuys is the Valley's civic center, home to the Van Nuys Airport and the Sepulveda Basin, with Lake Balboa and the Japanese Garden among the best outdoor spots in the Valley and a long run of family-run restaurants along Victory, Vanowen and Van Nuys Boulevard.

gm: Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)

places.w: A long-running Puebla-style torta shop in a small strip mall.
A Cuban-inspired spot built around charcoal-grilled chicken, with a pastry case and plenty of seating.
places.o: Half a chicken with black beans and yellow rice, or a Cubano.

places.w: A tiny burger counter tucked beside a liquor store, turning out excellent smash burgers.
places.o: A double smash and the loaded fries.

places.w: A big park around a lake with a 1.3-mile loop path, paddle boats and plenty of birds.
places.o: Walk the loop in the morning; come in spring for the cherry blossoms.

places.w: A peaceful formal garden with waterfalls, koi ponds and a teahouse in the Sepulveda Basin. Entry is a few dollars.
places.o: Check the hours before you go; it keeps limited days.
